items.passage: Transcript: Good morning, this is Mateus Albrecht from the Registrar's Office, with some changes for the next three weeks. Normally you pick up printed transcripts at our service counter in Room 127 of Marston Hall. While that counter is being rebuilt, continuing students will collect them at the cashier's window on the ground floor. Graduating seniors are handled separately this time: your transcripts will be held in Room 233, on the upper floor, because we're packaging them with your degree audit. Graduate students aren't affected and still pick theirs up at the graduate office in Pellow Annex. Processing usually takes three business days, but please allow five for now, since we're short two staff members. One more thing. If your request involves a name change, call extension 5208 before you send anything, online or on paper. Please don't bring it up at the pickup windows; they can't see your records.
